title: Bug — Vaporize must reconcile nested Windows packages through their repository-owned Bead home
description: Vaporize discovered i18n-universal's repository-owned Kura/Bead home but passed the nested Translate CLI package directory as repairHome. Containment correctly rejected that impossible boundary before the Windows build could start.
acceptanceCriteria: Vaporize derives the narrowest common owning directory for a nested package and its discovered Bead home.
The Windows regression test is stored under the Vaporize CUJ package's windows directory and references this Bead.
Vaporize reaches the ordinary source-gate result for Translate instead of failing Bead path containment.
The Translate Windows build is executed through Vaporize's swift-win authority.
risks: Weakening containment could allow repair artifacts outside the product repository; the fix must change the declared owning root without disabling path validation.

evidence.validation: Vaporize swift-win passed the nested repository-owned Bead home regression test using Swift Testing.

resolution: Vaporize derives the common owning home shared by a nested package and its repository-owned Kura space without weakening containment.
